svg.title: Single comb tree: 31 new-position scans, 64 valid starts
svg.desc: A 32 by 32 induced grid tree. Eight comb layers connect through the rightmost column. Orange circles show all 64 valid translations of a 32-vertex template; the blue copy starts at row 4, column 4.

g.text: 单棵梳形树 / One connected comb tree
One copy / 一份完整副本
间隔行仅此一格为道路
Only road in each gap row
坐标从 0 开始 / Zero-based coordinates
